candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable (~2s), propagating 503 from inventory and 502 from order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; root cause of redis timeout (load, saturation, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading to order and gateway checkout 502s; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502 counts. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Redis-side telemetry absent, so cause of the timeout is bounded but not fully attributed.
